At result _build_evidence returns before constructing a node, so the scene tree, the measured AABB and therefore the grid's auto-grounding are what they were. The 11 cells across 6 maps (WaveFunctions_Intro and its three parts, Corridor_WaveFunctions_Intro, Curation_Bay_wavefunctions_10) are bare `control_pendulum` or `control_pendulum:0:1.5:1` and pass no config key at all.
dna.was: four numeric exports and a generic apply_grid_config that did `if key in self: set(key, ...)`. The runner refused the token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS. This registry entry has described the artifact as having 'configurable control parameters - adjust damping, driving force, and frequency' and as offering 'the transition from periodic motion through quasi-periodicity to chaos' since it was written, and the file had NO DRIVE AT ALL: no driving force, no driving frequency, and nothing in it nonlinear enough to reach chaos. `resonance` is the value that makes the first half of that sentence true. The chaos claim remains false and is recorded here rather than papered over - a driven pendulum reaches chaos only at drive amplitudes far past the 0.45*PI clamp this file applies.
dna.note: THE FAULT CHECK CAME FIRST, AND IT IS NOT spring_demo's. spring_demo's damping slider stopped at c = 2.0 where critical damping for its own parameters was 6.32, so the one regime it existed to teach was off the end of the hardware. Here there is no slider and no clamp - damping is a bare @export float and the old generic setter would have taken any value - so critical damping WAS numerically reachable, at a per-frame multiplier of exactly 0.874, and nowhere written down. The fault is a UNIT, not a cap. damping is a per-physics-frame multiplier with no relation to the pendulum's own omega, so the same number is a different regime at a different length, and the declared critical_parameter IS the length. Expressed as a ratio the shipped 0.995 is zeta = 0.037 (omega0 = sqrt(9.8/0.6) = 4.04 rad/s, zeta = -ln(0.995)*60/(2*omega0)); expressed as anything else it is nothing. So the four non-default values are set as damping RATIOS against omega0 and stay honest if the length moves: underdamped 0.25, decay you can see inside six seconds and still crossing zero; critical 1.00, the fastest return that never crosses; overdamped 2.50, no crossing either and slower, which is the whole joke; resonance 0.08 with a drive at omega0, where DRIVE_AMP 0.06 gives a steady amplitude of 0.06/(2*0.08) = 0.375 rad, comfortably larger than the 0.3 rad start and comfortably inside the 0.45*PI clamp, so it reads as a swing that GROWS rather than as a clipped one.
dna.kin: regime is harmonic_motion_demo's word, and its first four values are that artifact's list character for character. The fifth, resonance, is a case this artifact can answer and the undriven siblings cannot, which is why it is ADDED rather than substituted - the shared four still mean next door exactly what they mean here. bouncing_ball is the precedent for taking this word and refusing part of its list (there is no critically-bouncing); here the list is taken whole and extended, which is the honest half of the same rule. evidence is the family word and the canonical four-value ladder, and it is ALSO what makes regime photographable at all.
dna.still_note: A PREDICTION, so the next sweep falsifies it instead of re-describing it: EXPECT regime TO MEASURE FLAT, AND DO NOT READ THAT AS AN INERT AXIS. This is slope_tangent_demo's fault exactly, and the arithmetic says so in advance. regime is invisible in a still of the pendulum itself - a rod photographed at one arbitrary phase puts free and underdamped somewhere in the swing and puts critical and overdamped BOTH hanging straight down, two values identical to the byte, which is a fact about the camera and not about the physics. So the regime is DRAWN, as theta(t) over six seconds integrated at build time with the same update rule _physics_process uses, on one fixed vertical scale so a decaying trace cannot be mistaken for a free one, and the fixture pins evidence=trace so that curve is present in every regime tile. BUT THAT CURVE IS AN ImmediateMesh LINE_STRIP, WHICH RASTERISES ONE PIXEL WIDE. At framing 0.7 the frame is about 1.20 m across, so a 0.60 m trace is half the frame wide and one pixel tall - on the order of 0.1% of frame changed between two regimes that differ wholesale. THE REMEDY IS INK, NOT framing: no framing value reaches 3% from a subject one pixel thick. It is also cheap and safe, because the plot is built only under evidence != result and NO placement uses a non-default value - rebuild the trace as a TRIANGLE_STRIP ribbon the way slope_tangent_demo's deepened pass did, and the axis becomes measurable without touching one of the 11 shipped cells. That was left undone in this pass ON PURPOSE and is recorded rather than silently skipped: it is a geometry change to a file committed minutes earlier, and this pass was forbidden from running Godot to confirm it compiles. framing 0.7 is set anyway for the shipped ink: the union box with the plot present is about 0.60 x 0.65 x 0.18 m, half-diagonal 0.45 m, so dist = 0.45/tan(17 deg) * PAD 1.9 * 0.7 = 1.96 m and the frame comes to 1.20 m against a 0.65 m subject. Cropping is arithmetically impossible above 1/PAD = 0.53, because the rig fits by bounding SPHERE.

B-DNA is right-handed, Z-DNA is left-handed, and the same sequence adopts both under different salt and strain - so a specimen jar that can only hold one is making a claim about which DNA counts as DNA. Implemented one node down in doublehelix.gd as a sign on the angle step (additive, default right, every other user of that scene untouched) and pushed through by the specimen's own export.
dna.still_note: every rung is meshes and transforms resolved during _ready - a moved lid, a shorter fluid cylinder, a doubled container, 220 grains on a golden-angle spiral with no randf in them. Nothing depends on the rotation or the emission pulse, so one frame is a complete account.

draw_calls_display.qfep_connection: Seven lines of code make the renderer confess its labor: one label polling RENDER_TOTAL_DRAW_CALLS every frame. The cost of appearing becomes an object you can stand beside — spectacle metering itself from inside the spectacle.

drawing_paper.description: Paper surface for drawing and artistic creation
drawing_paper.name: Drawing Paper
drawing_paper.dna_declined: 2026-08-05 - CANNOT BE DECLARED WITHOUT BREAKING THE GATE, and that is the finding. This token runs the same paper_draw_surface.gd as ball_painting_demo, so it already HAS the priming axis in code and it works here; the axis was declared, verified ok, and then withdrawn. check_dna_declarations.untracked_sources walks EVERY script a scene runs, and drawing_paper.tscn instantiates godot-xr-tools' pickable.gd and hand_pose_settings.gd for its grab pen - both under /addons/*, which is .gitignore line 13. Declaring anything here therefore adds two rows to 'DECLARED AXIS whose implementing script is NOT IN THE REPOSITORY' and takes the gate's exit code from 0 to 2, even though the script that implements the axis is tracked and committed. The general fact, worth knowing before the next agent tries: no artifact whose .tscn contains an XR-Tools grabbable can carry a dna block until untracked_sources distinguishes the script that implements the axis from the vendored addons the scene merely instantiates. Until then this token shows in the orphan list ('promoted in code, undeclared in the registry'), which is a print and not a failure, and is TRUE.
drawing_paper.qfep_connection: A pickable pen whose tip raycasts into a GPU canvas; with wet paint enabled, a simulation pass keeps the ink flowing after the hand has left. The mark outlives the gesture and goes on negotiating — drawing as a deposit into a surface with its own weather.

drawing_pen.description: Pen tool for drawing on surfaces
drawing_pen.name: Drawing Pen
drawing_pen.qfep_connection: The pen holds no code — body and tip are bare meshes; the paper's raycast-and-texture surface does all the sensing and keeps every mark. Authorship migrates to the substrate, and the tool becomes an excuse to approach it.

Dürer's engraving of geometry's melancholy, staged as objects: the chapter's close made walkable, thought's tools lying idle around a mind that has run out of certainty.

filter_bubble_demo.description: Recommendation engine that narrows content over time.
filter_bubble_demo.name: Filter Bubble Demo
filter_bubble_demo.qfep_connection: The engine never deletes anything; it only stops sampling — and stopping sampling is indistinguishable from deletion unless something keeps drawing what was dropped. The ghost spiral is the artifact and the shrinking arc is only the evidence: nineteen rounds of personalisation left visible as nineteen foreclosures with timestamps, against a horizon ring the recommender cannot touch.

flow_field_painter.description: Paint with vector fields — particles follow the flow you create, tracing streamlines that reveal the hidden topology of your brushstrokes. Combines art and physics as your gestures define the force landscape that particles navigate.
flow_field_painter.name: Flow Field Painter
flow_field_painter.qfep_connection: Noise as structured randomness â€” not chaos, not order, but Î»-edge. Flow reveals hidden structure.

fluid_taxonomy_tree.description: A taxonomy that morphs. Categories branch, merge, dissolve.
fluid_taxonomy_tree.name: Fluid Taxonomy Tree
fluid_taxonomy_tree.qfep_connection: Each branch has no colour of its own — it shows the mean hue of whoever is currently inside it, so a category's identity visibly drifts every time a leaf walks across the ring or two branches fuse. The displaced counter climbs to 12 of 12 and stays there: a taxonomy is not a picture of relationships, it is a record of the last time someone decided.

force_field_visualizer.description: Visualize gravitational, electric, and magnetic force fields in 3D using arrow glyphs and particle tracers. Place sources and sinks to sculpt the field landscape, then release test particles to see how forces guide motion through space.
force_field_visualizer.name: Force Field Visualizer
force_field_visualizer.qfep_connection: Fields as invisible structure â€” order you can't see until you probe it. The hidden F that shapes everything.

dna.was: field_type was the @identity's declared critical_parameter, a live @export with a working setter and four VR buttons wired to it - and unreachable from a map token, because apply_grid_config's whole body was `pass`. Every room got POINT_CHARGE. The evidence apparatus was written on 2026-08-02 and never declared, so the sweep could not turn it either.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-03 - the runner refused this token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS, which was a fact about the registry: the evidence axis was already implemented in the script (result | trace | sources | longhand, taken character for character from wave_interference_tank) and the registry had never been told. Derived, not transcribed. This pass adds `law` and the config hook that reaches it. NOT named `field` although VectorFieldFlow declares an axis by that name - its values are shapes one synthetic flow is bent into, these are four named physical laws with four different falloffs, and only vortex/orbit and point_charge/sink even loosely correspond. field_strength and source_position remain unread by design: dials on a law, not a choice of law, and a still cannot tell a stronger field from a nearer one.

found_object_assembler.description: Grab scene fragments from a junk pile and compose freely.
found_object_assembler.name: Found Object Assembler
found_object_assembler.qfep_connection: The heap and the table hold the same objects; only one of them has a grid, and that is the entire difference between debris and a component. Bricolage is not the act of recombining found parts — it is the moment somebody decides where the cells start, after which the junk has somewhere it is supposed to be.

fractal_space.name: fractal_space
fractal_space.qfep_connection: Seeded diamond-square to depth five: each subdivision halves the step and scales displacement by a roughness constant, then the result is meshed and given collision. Scale-invariance becomes floor — you sample the recursion with your ankles, at exactly one height per footfall.

frame_counter_display.description: label.text = Engine.get_process_frames() — a live counter of rendered frames since startup
frame_counter_display.name: frame_counter_display
frame_counter_display.qfep_connection: Engine.get_process_frames() shown live — the render loop counting itself out loud. The most honest artifact in the room: a reminder that all this geometry is being redrawn dozens of times a second, that the still point and the solid cube are both, underneath, a number ticking up.

dna.default: reading=count, epoch=boot - the legacy three-line behaviour to the character, so all 11 existing placements are untouched
dna.was: three lines and zero exports: label.text = "%d" % Engine.get_process_frames(). The hard-coded parameter space was hiding in that one format string - a cumulative count is the least honest thing a frame counter can say, and the artifact's own truth line ('there is no continuous time in real-time 3D, only discrete frame steps') asks for the rate readout its @identity had been requesting since it was written
dna.note: declaration completed by hand - the promoting agent wrote the script and died on the session limit before declaring the axes

frames_display.name: frames_display
frames_display.qfep_connection: A Label3D printing frames-per-second inside the very frames it counts. The render loop's E_flux budget — normally invisible overhead — stands in the world as an object taxed by its own reading.

game_of_life_petri.description: Conway's Game of Life presented as a laboratory petri dish — cellular automata as biological experiment. Watch gliders, oscillators, and still lifes emerge from simple birth/death rules in a circular containment vessel.
game_of_life_petri.name: Game of Life Petri Dish
game_of_life_petri.qfep_connection: Game of Life operates at the edge of chaos â€” simple enough to be deterministic, complex enough to be unpredictable. Turing complete computation from four rules.

game_time_display.name: game_time_display
game_time_display.qfep_connection: Nothing but the engine's own uptime, formatted HH:MM:SS on a floating label: not world time, not story time, but how long the machine has been holding this world up — duration as infrastructure confession.

garbage_collector_demo.name: Garbage Collector Demo
garbage_collector_demo.qfep_connection: The collector never asks whether an object still works, only whether anyone can still reach it. Watching a dense, self-consistent island of cells go grey because one reference was dropped is watching unreachability do the condemning that uselessness gets blamed for.

glitch_body.description: Mesh that refuses stable form — a procedural sphere-like shape rebuilt every frame with time-varying noise perturbation and HSV hue cycling. Vertices oscillate, stretch, and collapse; the mesh is always transforming, never settling. A body in continuous becoming, resisting fixed categorization.
glitch_body.name: Glitch Body

grabable_agnes.name: Grabable Agnes
grabable_agnes.qfep_connection: An Agnes Martin grid — grey lines at 0.3 alpha on cream — bolted to a rigid body you can pick up and drop. The quietest painting in modernism is given mass and a collision shape; contemplation becomes subject to gravity.

grabable_mondrian.description: Interactive Mondrian composition that can be picked up, manipulated, and examined in VR space
grabable_mondrian.name: Grabable Mondrian
grabable_mondrian.qfep_connection: Neoplastic equilibrium regenerated on a ten-second timer, then mounted on a grabbable rigid body. Composition was supposed to be final; here it is a sample from a distribution that you can hold while it changes its mind.

graphics_monitor.description: 3D monitor with frame displaying visualization graphics. Use #vectors, #forces, #arrays, #waves, #randomness, or #procedural
graphics_monitor.name: Graphics Monitor
graphics_monitor.qfep_connection: A television for mathematics: the same frame accepts #vectors, #waves, or #polyhedra and simply changes channel. Explanation here is furniture — placed on the grid like a chair.

graphics_slideshow.description: Non-interactive visualization display that cycles through frames every 5 seconds. Use #topic:vectors, forces, arrays, waves, randomness, or procedural
graphics_slideshow.name: Graphics Slideshow
graphics_slideshow.qfep_connection: A textbook that turns its own pages: five seconds per frame, a SubViewport rendered to a sprite, no input accepted. The lesson advances whether or not you were looking — pedagogy's oldest politics, put on a timer.

graphics_slideshow_2d.description: 2D fullscreen slideshow - navigate with A/D, Left/Right, or Space. Press ESC to close
graphics_slideshow_2d.name: Graphics Slideshow 2D
graphics_slideshow_2d.qfep_connection: The same teaching boards flattened to fullscreen and put under keyboard command, A and D instead of walking. What VR stages as encounter, the 2D fallback admits is a deck of slides — same sequence, body discarded.

graphics_slideshow_all.description: Navigate through all graphics boards - use keyboard (A/D or Left/Right arrows) to flip through topics
graphics_slideshow_all.name: Graphics Slideshow All
graphics_slideshow_all.qfep_connection: Fourteen boards behind one screen, vectors through coordinate system, advanced by keypress; a map can pin the start_topic through grid config. The whole curriculum collapses to one index variable incremented mod fourteen — which is what a curriculum is, once you strip the walking.

grid_eye.description: Grid point visualization for spatial awareness
grid_eye.name: Grid Eye
grid_eye.qfep_connection: Every frame it rounds your position to integers, paints your cell red on a 24-by-24 texture, and asks aloud: in what way are we becoming a point on a grid? The answer is already executing in _process — quantization here is not a metaphor but a surveillance being applied to you.

hand_color_controller.description: Uses a 3D value mapper to live-adjust VR hand nail materials with a preview cube.
hand_color_controller.name: hand_color_controller
hand_color_controller.qfep_connection: relation: the nails' sibling mapper — the same live adjustment addressed to the whole hand; identity's palette widened one joint at a time.

hand_model.description: Static hand-model reference for VR scale and positioning — provides a human-proportioned anchor for sizing artifacts in the scene.
hand_model.name: hand_model
hand_model.qfep_connection: a human-proportioned reference hand — the room's quiet ruler; it marks the inhabited scale without asserting content.

harmonic_motion_demo.description: Interactive simple harmonic motion demonstration — a mass oscillating on a spring with real-time graphs of position, velocity, and acceleration. Adjust spring constant and mass to see how frequency depends on physical parameters.

dna.default: regime=free, record=both - free returns LEGACY_DAMPING_MAX = 1.0 so the DAMP slider maps through the identical lerp(0.0, 1.0, t) it always did, opens at 0.0 like the shipped panel spec, and both evidence meshes stay visible, so every existing placement (10 tokens across 8 maps, incl. the four WaveFunctions_Intro pages and VFM_06_Springs) renders exactly what it rendered before
dna.was: four NodePath exports and an apply_grid_config() whose body was `pass`. The DAMP slider was welded to an absolute 0..1 decay rate with no relation to the oscillator's own omega: at the initial omega = TAU that cap is zeta = 0.16, so every reachable position was underdamped and the critical and overdamped regimes - the two the subject is taught for - were off the end of the hardware. The reference curve and the lived trail were always drawn together, so the one place damping shows itself was overlaid by the undamped ideal.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-03 - the runner refused it for NO TURNABLE KNOBS. Same fault class the spring_demo pass found (a damping slider capped at 2.0 where critical damping was 6.32); here the fix is to express the span in units of omega so it stays honest when the FREQ slider moves. Each regime also OPENS inside the regime it names - an axis where every value started at damping 0 would photograph four identical stills. record shares 'trace' and 'bare' with the vector-bench family.

harmonic_motion_demo.name: Harmonic Motion Demo

dna.default: readout=numeral - the shipped path exactly. _build_readout()'s `numeral` case is a bare pass: no rail is built, no node is added, no visibility is touched, and _update_display still runs the same `%d` of ceil(health) and the same three colour branches in the same order. The three placements (ForcesArena, Forces_Drone_Game x2) carry no #readout token, so _read_readout() finds no config_readout metadata on the root and leaves the export where it was. apply_grid_config returns before touching anything unless a call actually names `readout` AND names a value in the allow-list AND names a different rung AND arrives after _ready has built once.
dna.was: no export of any kind - the runner refused this token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS. Thirteen lines that pushed ceil(health) into a Label3D the .tscn already contained, plus an if/elif chain on two bare literals (health <= 1.0 red, <= 2.0 yellow). GameManager ships max_player_health = 100.0 and nothing in the project calls set_max_health, so those two verdicts own 2% of the range and have never fired in a live room: the panel has read a green 100 in every placement since it was written.
dna.note: SHARED WORD, NOT A NEW ONE. `readout` = none|numeral|gradation|lattice is taken verbatim from line_interface, xyz_slider_plate, xyz_coordinates, qfep_calibrator and qfep_reactor, where it already means 'what does this apparatus tell you about the value it holds'. The alias table is not copied either - gameplay_readout.readout_name() forwards to XYZSliderPlate.readout_name(), so `#readout: ticks` means the same rung on all seven artifacts and the lists cannot drift.
dna.twin: hits_reset_display is the same scene twice (same 1.0 x 0.2 x 0.1 frame, same subtracted well, same ValueLabel and TitleLabel, different accent colour and different arithmetic) and is declared with the same word and the same values on the same day. THEY SHOULD MEASURE ALIKE at rungs 0-2; that is the check on the shared vocabulary, not a coincidence to explain afterwards. At rung 3 they are deliberately MIRRORED - this panel paints its hot band over 0..1 of 100 and the twin paints its over 2..100 - because the two files really do privilege opposite ends of one number.
dna.harness: no fixture or framing hint needed, and the reason is measured rather than assumed. capture_multi_angle._get_combined_aabb counts CSGShape3D and Label3D as well as MeshInstance3D, and the registry's own measurements block already reads aabb_size [1.0, 0.2, 0.1] from the CSG frame, so this artifact frames. The `none` rung HIDES the ValueLabel rather than freeing it, precisely so the AABB is identical at all four values and the sweep's fixed camera does not move between variants. The rail is hung UNDER the panel (y 0.05..0.19) rather than on its face: the ValueLabel is a 48pt glyph at the default pixel_size, roughly 0.48 m tall on a 0.2 m panel, so anything drawn on the face would have been read as a change to the numeral instead of an addition beside it.

health_display.qfep_connection: a live health readout wired to the game state — instrument panel, always present but never the lesson; it marks the inhabited stakes.

helper_arm.name: Helper Arm

dna.default: readout=numeral - the shipped path exactly. _build_readout()'s `numeral` case is a bare pass: no rail is built, no node is added, no visibility is touched, and _update_display still computes the same max(0, max_player_health - health), prints the same '%d / %d' and takes the same three colour branches. The three placements (ForcesArena, Forces_Drone_Game x2, one of them at rotation 180) carry no #readout token, so _read_readout() finds no config_readout metadata on the root and leaves the export where it was. apply_grid_config is guarded identically to the twin's.
dna.was: no export of any kind - the runner refused this token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS. Sixteen lines that pushed a count into a Label3D the .tscn already contained. Its own comment says 'we already have a Health display (3 -> 0)' and its thresholds are written for a three-hit game, but GameManager ships max_player_health = 100.0 and nothing calls set_max_health, so this panel has read '0 / 100' in every room it has ever stood in and every hit after the second lands inside one undifferentiated red verdict. Reported, not fixed: correcting it would move three live placements.
dna.note: SHARED WORD, NOT A NEW ONE. `readout` = none|numeral|gradation|lattice is taken verbatim from line_interface, xyz_slider_plate, xyz_coordinates, qfep_calibrator and qfep_reactor. The alias table forwards to XYZSliderPlate.readout_name() through the shared body commons/visualaid/gameplay/gameplay_readout.gd, which also owns the rail geometry - written once so the two siblings cannot grow different scales out of the same word.
dna.twin: health_display is the same scene twice and is declared with the same word and the same values on the same day; they should MEASURE ALIKE at rungs 0-2. At rung 3 the evidence is deliberately MIRRORED: the twin counts down what remains and paints its hot band across 0..1 of a hundred-unit scale, this one counts up what has been taken and paints its across 2..100 - so 98% of everything this counter can display is already inside the terminal verdict, while the twin's fires only in the last 1%. Both rungs draw the same thing (the values at which the code changes its verdict); the asymmetry is the artifacts', not the vocabulary's, and it has been true since both were written and invisible from either panel.
dna.harness: as the twin: no fixture or framing hint. _get_combined_aabb counts the CSG frame and the Label3D, the registry's measurements block already reads a real 1.0 x 0.2 x 0.1 box, and `none` hides the ValueLabel rather than freeing it so the fixed sweep camera sees the same box at all four values. The index sits at the LEFT stop at rest here and at the RIGHT stop on the twin, which is the cheapest available check that the two panels were actually swept as different artifacts rather than as one scene under two names.

hits_reset_display.description: Counter panel showing hits taken toward map reset — displays N / max, incrementing as the player accumulates damage from hazards.
hits_reset_display.name: hits_reset_display
hits_reset_display.qfep_connection: the damage counter toward map reset — instrument panel, always present but never the lesson; consequence made legible.

info_display.qfep_connection: A scrollable text panel that disciplines the hand before it delivers the text: enter its pose area and your fingers are forced into pointing. Reading is given a prescribed gesture — the interface decides what a hand is for.

infokiosk.description: Freestanding kiosk combining a 2D-in-3D message console with a vertical status monitor for lab readouts.
infokiosk.name: infokiosk
infokiosk.qfep_connection: A message console and a vertical status monitor bolted into one freestanding cabinet: the lab's logging given a body you can walk up to. GameManager's console stream — normally developer exhaust — becomes furniture, the system narrating itself in public.

interactable_demo.description: Inspection rig laying out one of every VR control type in a single row — buttons, knobs, sliders (smooth/horizontal/snap/zero), lever, and wheel — each labelled for testing and review.
interactable_demo.name: interactable_demo
interactable_demo.qfep_connection: One of every VR control laid out in a row — buttons, knobs, sliders, dials — the inspection rig for how a hand touches this world. Not a wave but the *interface* to waves: the chapter's honest admission that oscillation is only teachable if you can grab a parameter and turn it, and here is every way this project lets you turn one.

jelly_variants.description: A collection of soft body jelly cubes with different material properties — varying stiffness, damping, and viscosity. Poke, squeeze, and throw them to feel how parameters shape deformation behavior. A tactile physics playground.
jelly_variants.name: Jelly Cube Variants
jelly_variants.qfep_connection: Parameter space exploration â€” stiffness, pressure, damping create different morphological behaviors

julia_set_explorer.description: Navigate the infinite complexity of Julia sets — zoom into fractal boundaries where order and chaos interweave at every scale. Adjust the complex parameter c to morph between connected and disconnected Julia sets, watching the Mandelbrot set's DNA unfold.
julia_set_explorer.name: Julia Set Explorer
julia_set_explorer.qfep_connection: Julia sets from c inside Mandelbrot are connected (ordered). Outside = disconnected dust (chaos). The c parameter IS a Î»-like dial.

kitbash_station.description: Combine random artifact fragments into new forms.
kitbash_station.name: Kitbash Station

latent_space_walk.description: Walk through a VAE/GAN latent space.
latent_space_walk.name: Latent Space Walk
latent_space_walk.qfep_connection: A latent space has no gaps: the four corners are the only points anything was ever learned at, and every form between them decodes to something nobody trained on. The model is mostly made of what it was never shown, and here that middle is floor you can stand on.

adjacency_shelf.description: A two-tone laminate wedge shelf holding three stock props. The shelf answers to its own contents: a coherent triptych fuses the laminate into one surface, an incoherent one splits it and runs a seam down the wedge. Display furniture is never neutral. The degradation is real geometry at a lower sample rate, not a blur over a fine mesh. Config: #side:rich#poor_samples:4

Worse, the integer was unreachable from a map token even by hand: map_data.json config values arrive as STRINGS, so 'lsystem_editor#preset:5' set a typed int property from "5", was rejected, and silently rendered Plant. Four maps, one grammar. depth did not exist at all - generations was pinned to the preset's own number.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-03, the botanical_flower case: the runner refused this token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS and the axis was already sitting in the source. Derived from PRESETS, not transcribed - the seven names are the preset labels lowercased with the spaces closed up. `preset` is deliberately NOT declared alongside `grammar`: they are the same axis addressed twice, and declaring both would sweep the same seven pictures under two names. preset stays as the VR slider's live variable and the keyboard shortcut's target. angle_degrees is not an axis either - it is a dial ON a grammar, and every preset already carries its own angle.

magnifying_glass.name: Magnifying Glass
magnifying_glass.qfep_connection: The lens bends no light; the shader rescales SCREEN_UV by 0.7 around center and re-presents pixels already rendered, with a Fresnel rim for a frame. Magnification as honest fake — in a rendered world, 'closer' is only a resampling.

magnifying_glass_red.description: Red variant of magnifying glass for specialized viewing
magnifying_glass_red.name: Magnifying Glass Red
magnifying_glass_red.qfep_connection: The same screen-space lens, except the fragment shader zeroes green and blue on the way out. The filter adds no red — it deletes everything else, which is how most ways of seeing actually operate.

magnifying_glass_tool.description: Advanced magnifying glass tool with additional features
magnifying_glass_tool.name: Magnifying Glass Tool
magnifying_glass_tool.qfep_connection: Three lenses on rigid grabbable handles — two clear, one that keeps only the red channel — laid out for comparison. Instruments arrive in sets so that seeing itself becomes the variable while the thing under the glass stays constant.

mario_cube.description: An interactive surprise cube inspired by classic platformer mechanics — hit it from below to trigger the NextCube signal, remove the DarkSphere, and reveal a rainbow effect. A playful intersection of game design and signal systems.
mario_cube.name: Mario Cube

dna.default: retention=none - the shipped lineage exactly. _ret_build() matches `none` first and builds nothing at all, so the artifact stays a pick-up cube plus an empty ImmediateMesh, which is what it has always been. MEASURED, not assumed: 7 mentions across 6 map files by two reach-paths - four bare tokens `mario_cube_time_trace:0:1:0.5` (WaveFunctions_Intro and its three parts) and two curation_station collections (Corridor_WaveFunctions_Intro, Curation_Bay_wavefunctions_4) whose #layout / #with_wall / #with_pillars / #with_barrier flags belong to the station and not to this artifact. Not one carries a retention key, and apply_grid_config returns on its first line unless a config actually names one. The four bare tokens also carry scale 0.5, so a record a map opted into would render at half size in them.
dna.was: refused by the runner as NO TURNABLE KNOBS. The file did export seven knobs; what it had none of was a knob one still can tell apart. time_axis_speed, sample_interval, trail_max_points, fade_trail_over_time and fade_duration are a rate, an interval, a cap and a decay - the info_board class exactly - and target_path and trail_color are a wiring fact and a colour. So this promotion is new code rather than a declaration: five values of a STANDING record, appended after the legacy _ready body, none of which the shipped file could express.
dna.shares_vocabulary_with: mystic_writing_pad (where the word comes from), draw_dot, draw_dot_time_domain, draw_triangle_faces, grab_sphere_point_snap, interactive_point_origin_force, player_trace, oscillation_controlled_cube - `retention` with the same five values in the same order and the same default. ADOPTED, not inherited: this script extends Node3D and shares no line with draw_dot, so the five builders are written in this artifact's own idiom. The claims are the family's; the geometry is a waveform receding along +Z rather than a stroke on a plane, because +Z is where this artifact puts time.
dna.declined: time_axis_speed and sample_interval - a rate and an interval, which one still cannot tell apart; that is the info_board result verbatim. trail_max_points and fade_duration are the same fault wearing a memory-budget costume. And the LIVE trace is declined as a subject: PickUpCube is a plain Node3D that nothing moves without a player, so with no player every sample lands on the same (x, y) and the +Z push draws them into a straight line whose only variable is how long the capture has been running - a degenerate figure that is the same figure at every value. draw_dot_time_domain declined its own live trace for exactly this reason; this is the second time the corpus has found it, from the other end of the family.
dna.still_note: the record is built once in _ready and never moves - no randf on that path, and _process touches no part of it - so a still is a complete account of it. It spans 0.44 m across, 0.32 m high and 0.70 m into +Z, which puts it about 0.4 m past the cell edge behind the cube. Deliberate, and far more bounded than the behaviour it depicts: the live trail leaves the cell after 0.8 s of play and is six metres out after ten.

mario_cube_time_trace.description: Pick-up cube with time-domain trace in +Z, like pendulum trail.

matrix_multiply_visual.name: Matrix Multiply Visual

memory_display.name: memory_display
memory_display.qfep_connection: A label reading out the process's own static memory in megabytes, refreshed every frame. The world confesses its heap: everything you have walked past is still resident somewhere inside that number.

mondrian_2d.description: A classic Mondrian composition rendered in 2D with geometric precision and De Stijl color palette
mondrian_2d.name: Mondrian 2D Canvas
mondrian_2d.qfep_connection: A 60:55 canvas that redraws its grid of blacks and primaries every ten seconds from random splits. Dynamic equilibrium — Mondrian's word for a balance found once — is recast as a generator's output distribution: F_order as style, E_flux on a timer.

mondrian_3d_display.description: 3D representation of Mondrian compositions with depth and spatial presentation
mondrian_3d_display.name: Mondrian 3D Display

monte_carlo_estimator.description: Estimate mathematical quantities through random sampling — watch as dart throws approximate pi, random walks estimate integrals, and stochastic processes converge to deterministic values. The power of randomness as a computational tool.
monte_carlo_estimator.name: Monte Carlo Estimator
monte_carlo_estimator.qfep_connection: Order (Ï€) emerges from randomness through accumulation. Law of large numbers as F-minimization.

nail_color_controller.description: Uses a 3D value mapper to live-adjust VR hand nail materials with a preview cube.
nail_color_controller.name: nail_color_controller
nail_color_controller.qfep_connection: relation: the nails — the chapter's ruled connective heart (L-019, hero by fiat, exempt from every score). A 3D value mapper adjusts the VR hands' own nail material, live, with a preview cube: color applied not to an exhibit but to YOU. Every other room shows color at a distance; here perception paints the perceiver, and the hand that points at the chapter carries the chapter.

non_binary_classifier.description: ML classifier that resists binary convergence.
non_binary_classifier.name: Non-Binary Classifier
non_binary_classifier.qfep_connection: The optimiser is ordinary logistic descent and it is working correctly; what will not hold still is the ground truth, because every sample inside the margin has its label re-drawn before the descent can use it. Set the margin to zero and it converges in seconds — convergence was never a property of the algorithm, it was a claim that everyone had already been sorted.

orbital_mechanics_demo.description: Interactive orbital mechanics simulation — launch satellites, adjust velocity and angle, and watch Kepler's laws emerge from Newton's gravity. Explore circular, elliptical, parabolic, and hyperbolic orbits by tuning initial conditions.
orbital_mechanics_demo.name: Orbital Mechanics Demo
orbital_mechanics_demo.qfep_connection: Orbit as dynamic equilibrium â€” perpetual falling, never landing. Balance between kinetic and potential. Stability from motion.

oscilloscope.name: Oscilloscope

oscilloscope_artifact.name: Oscilloscope
oscilloscope_artifact.qfep_connection: Five graspable sliders — two frequencies, phase, amplitude, time-per-division — feed a phosphor trace that flips between waveform, Lissajous, and XY. Signal only becomes shape when one oscillation is plotted against another; the instrument stages relation, not tone.

overfitting_demo.name: Overfitting Demo
overfitting_demo.qfep_connection: Two error numbers computed from one fit: the training figure falls to zero as the polynomial gains coefficients, the held-out figure turns and climbs, and the gap between them is the model memorising fifteen accidents of collection. Accuracy measured on the data you fitted is not a measurement, it is a mirror.

perlin_terrain_sculptor.description: Sculpt terrain using Perlin noise parameters — adjust octaves, persistence, lacunarity, and scale to shape landscapes from smooth rolling hills to jagged mountain ranges. Real-time terrain generation making noise mathematics tangible.

dna.default: assay=none - the `_:` branch of _build_assay, which does not even create the Assay wrapper node, so the bare 0.16 m dish stands on nothing exactly as it did in all 5 rooms. Every rung builds under one Node3D appended AFTER the worms, so no legacy child index moves and _auto_ground_artifact - which types only the root's DIRECT children - cannot see any of it. All 5 placements are the bare token `petri_dish_worms:180:0.8`; the `#with_wall` tails that show up in a grep belong to the curation_station token that NAMES this artifact, not to this one.
dna.was: DERIVED, not composed. The axis, its allow-list, the five builders and the spawn_seed pin were already in commons/artifacts/petri_dish_worms/petri_dish_worms.gd and the registry had never been told, so the sweep could not reach any of it - the column_3_z case a second time. What this pass added is the declaration, the fixture, and a guard: apply_grid_config fired _respawn_worms and _rebuild_assay on the mere PRESENCE of a key, so a token restating the value the dish already held threw the population away; it now assigns only on a legal AND different value and refuses to touch anything before _ready has built once. _read_dna was added so a token that asks for an apparatus builds it once in _ready instead of building the bare dish and tearing it down a frame later.
dna.note: assay is the softbody bench family's word and its five values, character for character - abject_bench, becoming_bench, membrane_bench and eleven more already ask what apparatus a specimen is surrounded by, and a petri dish is the oldest member of that question even though it joined the word last. `control` is the rung that argues hardest: a second, identical, EMPTY dish standing 0.40 m away turns a thing you are watching into an experiment you could disagree with, and its content is an ABSENCE - WormContainer is not duplicated. The specimen is deliberately not routed through the axis: every rung spawns the same population with the same colours and the same sine, because a variant that changed the worms would be changing the answer rather than the showing.
dna.still_note: THE WRIGGLE IS NOT AN AXIS AND CANNOT BE. oscillation_speed, worm_speed and the sine phase are rates; a still frame holds none of them, and the artifact's own essence line is a function of t. assay is the honest axis here precisely because every rung is standing apparatus - a graduated post, a second dish, a ruled plate, a glass case - photographable while nothing moves. The chart's growth curve is a FIXED logistic for the same reason: a rung that rolled dice would make every capture a different picture.
dna.fixture_note: spawn_seed is a fixture and NOT an axis. This artifact draws six unseeded numbers per worm at spawn (angle, radius, heading, phase, speed jitter, hue) and one more per worm per frame while it crawls, so without a pin the five assay frames are five different populations in five different colours and the critic reads that noise as a confident bite. A seed ladder would be five samples of one rule, which is the picture the dish already had.
dna.framing_note: unchecked against a capture in this pass, and worth a look before any verdict is read as a fact about the axis. The subject is a 0.32 m dish; _setup_controls hangs a rack panel at (0, 0.5, 0.6), `control` puts a second dish 0.40 m to the right and `vitrine` a 0.42 m case around the first, so the union-of-variants camera is pulled well back from the dish that carries the worms.

petri_dish_worms.description: Simulated worm-like organisms wriggling in a petri dish — simple steering behaviors and sinusoidal body motion create surprisingly lifelike movement. Emergence of biological-looking behavior from minimal procedural rules.
petri_dish_worms.name: Petri Dish Worms

pick_up_cube.capacity: MOVE an object through space and understand translation as carried displacement.
pick_up_cube.description: A grab-and-carry cube that turns translation into a bodily action. The object does not change shape or orientation much; what matters is that its position is rewritten by the player's movement through space. In puzzle contexts that simple displacement becomes rule-bearing and consequential. It is translation reduced to a portable primitive.
interactions: grab the cube and carry it through the map
drop it onto targets or through gates
change point or value settings through map config
compare object movement against static reference geometry
pick_up_cube.name: Pick Up Cube
pick_up_cube.qfep_connection: Pure S as carried displacement: the cube stays itself while its coordinates change. The artifact isolates translation as the simplest embodied state update.

pickable_showcase.name: pickable_showcase
pickable_showcase.qfep_connection: A census of everything that consents to the hand: cubes, sticks, planes, five Platonic solids, a line, a point, a sheet of paper, each on its own pedestal. Grab is the project's first verb, and here it is conjugated through every geometry at once.

pickup_gate.capacity: REASON about threshold state change: when enough objects move through, the gate transforms from closed to open.
pickup_gate.description: A blocking gate whose state depends on how many pickup cubes have crossed the threshold. Its geometry is simple, but its logic makes transformation legible as a rule: the gate is closed, then open, because enough translated objects changed the count. That turns motion into conditional infrastructure. It teaches that state change can be triggered by accumulated displacement.

dna.default: notice=count - the shipped Label3D printing 'Collect N more (x/N)', the only thing this scene has ever said. The axis adds exactly one line to the legacy path (label.visible = is_open or notice == 'count'), which evaluates true always at the default and restates the label's own default visibility, so both existing placements render unchanged in every frame
dna.was: a singleton with three exports, none of them an argument: required_pickups is the SIZE of the demand, gate_color and gate_open_color are its livery. The design question the artifact had never been asked is how a rule announces itself on the wall that enforces it - and it had answered it once, by accident, in digits
dna.kin: deliberately NOT the readout ladder shared by line / line_interface / xyz_slider_plate. That word is honest about a continuous value you are setting, and its fourth rung 'lattice' means the privileged whole-number set drawn standing; a count has no privileged subset, so the rung collapses and the family's fourth claim would have to be faked. This artifact also owns a BARRIER, which no measuring instrument does, and the barrier can be the readout
dna.fixture_note: the demand defaults to 1, and at 1 the countable values degenerate - slots is a single socket and barrier is a single band indistinguishable from the shipped box. Five is the smallest demand at which 'countable vacancies' and 'a banded wall' are things a still can show. This stages the bench only; no map is changed

interactions: carry pickup cubes into the gate zone
configure how many pickups are required through map tokens
watch the gate open once the threshold is met
use gate color or count settings to stage different collection puzzles
pickup_gate.name: Pickup Gate
pickup_gate.qfep_connection: Transformation here is thresholded state change. Repeated object translations alter the count until the gate preserves a new open identity.

player_position.name: player_position
player_position.qfep_connection: A label that does nothing but say where you are — (x, y, z) to two decimals, refreshed every frame, patiently re-searching the tree until a player exists. The coordinate system's view of you, posted inside your own world: to the grid, a body is three floats.

player_position_to_console.name: player_position_to_console
player_position_to_console.registry_note: Headless console printer — scene root is Node, not Node3D, so it cannot be placed in a map. Kept for direct scene use only.

player_presence_indicator.name: player_presence_indicator
player_presence_indicator.qfep_connection: Presence here is not proximity but scene-graph membership — a label polls five times a second for whether ../../XROrigin3D resolves, and calls that "Player detected". Being seen by this world means being instantiated in its tree.

point_is.name: point_is
point_is.registry_note: RETIRED 2026-07-29 (build-or-retire triage): Registered scene is an empty stub; `point` already carries the coordinate reading.

polyhedron_nets_cube.description: Cube net visualization with fold animation. DNA: net selects WHICH of the eleven distinct cube nets is unfolded — latin_cross (the shipped 1-4-1 band with both flaps on one square), staircase (2-2-2, three dominoes stepping), zed (1-4-1 with the flaps at opposite ends) and two_rows (3-3). fold selects where the fold has got to — animated (the shipped tween), closed, hinged, flat. Use #net: and #fold:. Also configurable via #fold_duration, #fold_delay, #auto_fold.

dna.default: fold=animated, net=latin_cross - a no-op on both. latin_cross calls _create_cube_faces() untouched (same six faces, same five hinges, same TopHinge/BottomHinge/LeftHinge/RightHinge/BackHinge names, same 0.15 delay on the back flap) and the generic builder is never entered; animated falls to the `_:` arm of _apply_fold_mode, which is `if auto_fold: _play_fold_animation()` - character for character the line it replaced. All 7 existing placements animate exactly as before, scene tree and capture AABB included
dna.was: the exports EXISTED and the registry had never declared them - fold_duration, fold_delay, fold_hold, auto_fold, loop_fold, fold_progress, all reachable from a map token and none declared. That was the right call for the wrong reason: every one of them is a rate or a delay, and this loop's evidence is one still PNG per value, which cannot see a rate. A sweep over fold_duration would have published six identical cubes at six speeds - a finished-looking experiment answering nothing, which is exactly what info_board's five-duration sweep already cost this project. Underneath them the artifact drew ONE of the eleven cube nets, hard-coded face by face in _create_cube_faces
dna.note: `net` is the axis that carries the file's own truth line - a polyhedron is a flat thing that folded. Drawing a single net makes the fold look like a property of THAT shape rather than of the cube; standing a 2-2-2 staircase and a 3-3 double row beside the 1-4-1 cross is the statement that four different flat things close into the same solid and the solid does not remember which. `fold` is the state, not the rate: flat is the plan (surface area before volume), hinged at 0.45 is the only pose where the hinges themselves are visible as hinges, closed is the finished solid. animated is kept as the default because it is what shipped, and its still is repeatable rather than arbitrary - the tween is deterministic, so the capturer's 1.1 s settle always lands about a quarter of the way in.
dna.derivation: the four net values were NOT chosen by eye. Every 6-cell polyomino was enumerated, folded through the same hinge-sign rule this file uses, and checked for landing on six distinct cube faces; that recovered exactly the eleven known nets, which is simultaneously the proof that the generic folder is correct and the proof that the shipped latin_cross hierarchy it reproduces was correct. Two of the first candidate 2-3-1 layouts FAILED that check and were dropped rather than shipped - at fold=flat a broken net looks perfectly fine, and nobody would have caught it until someone set fold=closed in a map.
dna.kin: `closure` was considered and declined. animatedcubebuilder uses it for strata/scaffold/solid, which asks what the finished thing is MADE of; this asks how far along the folding is, and the value lists cannot transfer. Taking the word without the answers would have been the dishonest half of a shared vocabulary, so `fold` - the file's own language, and its declared critical_parameter - is used instead.
dna.harness_note: the fixture pins fold=flat. The eleven nets are only distinguishable from each other while FLAT: at fold=closed all four values are the same cube, which is the artifact's whole point and would read as an inert axis. cabinet_sweep lets a swept axis override the fixture, so this is a no-op whenever fold is one of the two axes picked (it is declared first, so it normally is) and is the difference between measuring net and measuring nothing whenever it is not. Note also that net changes the flat FOOTPRINT - a 3-3 double row is 5 squares wide against the cross's 4 - so part of any measured bite at fold=flat is the fixed camera fitting a wider union. That is honest: a different net genuinely is a different-shaped flat object.

polyhedron_nets_cube.name: polyhedron_nets_cube
polyhedron_nets_cube.qfep_connection: A cube unfolded flat and folded again before you — the solid revealed as a hinged sheet of six quads. The net is the primitive confessing how it was made: every volume in this world is a surface that agreed to close.

pop_music_demo.description: Interactive generative pop music sequencer with dynamic chord progressions.
pop_music_demo.name: Pop Music Demo
pop_music_demo.qfep_connection: Four chords in a random major key, kick on one and three, hats on the offbeats — the whole song is decompressed from pop's rule-set at load time, every sample synthesized. F_order wearing a genre: intro, verse, and chorus are three densities of the same progression, crossfaded.

portal.description: A vertical portal frame that teleports the player to a destination.
portal.name: Portal
portal.qfep_connection: The frame moves no one; it emits teleporter_activated and lets the sequence system decide what through means. Passage as administration — blue beam when the petition will be honored, red when the door persists but the institution has closed.

pressure_soft_body.description: Inflatable soft body with internal pressure control.
pressure_soft_body.name: Pressure Soft Body
pressure_soft_body.qfep_connection: Pressure is not inflation, it is a disagreement: the solver pushes every vertex out along its normal and the springs pull it back, and the shape you see is where the two settle. Open the mesh anywhere and the argument has no interior to be about, so the body goes limp no matter what the number says.

profiler_flame_graph.description: Interactive flame graph of nested function calls.
profiler_flame_graph.name: Profiler Flame Graph
profiler_flame_graph.qfep_connection: The flame graph refuses to let performance be a scalar: a frame time is one number, but the shape that number has is a topology, and total time tells you which subtree is expensive while only self time tells you which function is. Every optimisation aimed at the widest bar instead of the hottest one was aimed at a container.

queer_morphology_specimen.description: A procedural specimen that defies binary classification — its form shifts between categories, refusing stable taxonomy. A critical theory artifact embodying the QFEP framework's challenge to normative boundaries in biological and computational classification.
queer_morphology_specimen.name: Queer Morphology Specimen
queer_morphology_specimen.qfep_connection: THIS IS QFEP EMBODIED. Î» drives orderâ†’chaos transition in soft body physics. Ï† encodes resistance/embrace of change. At Î»â‰ˆ0.5, specimen breathes at edge of chaos â€” where life emerges. Queer morphology = form as process, not fixed state.

random_space.description: A crystal that contains mathematical chaos algorithms
random_space.name: random_space
random_space.qfep_connection: The floor re-rolls its own heights every tick while collision updates on a slower interval, so what you see and what holds you are briefly two different terrains — chaos rationed to protect the frame rate and the ankles.

dna.framing_note: MEASURED, not guessed, and the number comes out of this file: aabb_size above is [11.0, 0.24, 20.0]. Fit-by-diagonal puts the sweep camera about 71 m out, where 0.24 m of relief is roughly four pixels of a 760 px frame - the documented fit-by-diagonal-on-a-thin-subject fault, and it would have reported a real axis as inert. This axis does not live in the silhouette at all: it lives in the SHADING, because the field is sampled every 0.22 m in x and 0.40 m in z with a peak-to-peak of 0.24 m, so adjacent vertices differ by up to 50 degrees of slope and the surface reads as texture. 0.32 puts the camera about 23 m out, where a cell is 12-22 px and the speckle statistics of the four laws are legible. The slab will overfill the frame and that is intended: the subject is the field, not its outline.
dna.default: law=uniform - and a SHORT-CIRCUIT rather than a recomputation. At `uniform` _draw returns `rng.randf_range(-chaos_level, chaos_level)`, which is the shipped expression itself, same call, same argument order, one draw from the same seeded stream; it does not re-derive the same number through randf(), which would be equal today and hostage tomorrow to how the engine implements randf_range. The .tscn's own values are untouched (seed_value 1, chaos_level 1.0, height_scale 0.12, resolution 50, space_size 11x20, enable_animation false), so the three rooms get the field they have always had. MEASURED, not assumed: 3 mentions across 3 map files - bare `random_space` in Random_Space and Room_Random_Space, and `random_space:0:-0.3:1.4` in Corridor_Random_Space, where the trailing numbers are rotation and y-offset consumed by the grid and not by this artifact. Not one of them carries a law key, and apply_grid_config returns without regenerating unless a key is present AND its value differs from the one the node already holds.
dna.was: eighteen exports and no way to reach any of them. TopologySpace declares no apply_grid_config and RandomSpace had none either, so chaos_level, seed_value, animation_type and the rest were editor-only: every placement got the identical field and map_data could not say otherwise. The runner refused it as NO TURNABLE KNOBS. Underneath that, the artifact named for randomness knew exactly ONE meaning of the word - a single hard-coded uniform draw per vertex - while sitting in the sequence that exists to teach that random is not one thing.
dna.note: THE FOUR LAWS ARE MONOTONE TRANSFORMS OF THE SAME DRAW, which is what makes them comparable rather than merely different. Each law consumes exactly one number per vertex from the same seeded stream and each is non-decreasing in it, so vertex i gets the same u under all four and a peak stays a peak: the four surfaces share their layout exactly and differ only in how amplitude is distributed over it. Four fields drawn from four streams would also have differed, and the difference would have been the streams. That alignment rests on randf_range being one linear randf, which it is in Godot 4; the DEFAULT rests on nothing of the kind, because at uniform the transform branch never runs at all. gaussian uses the A&S 26.2.23 normal quantile (error < 4.5e-4, four orders finer than a vertex of this mesh can show); poisson is the pmf accumulated directly at lambda 1.5 and capped at 4, giving five populated terraces; exponential is the inverse CDF at rate 3, where the median vertex sits at 0.23 of the range and about one in twenty saturates - the only asymmetric law of the four, and the one that gives the ground a base level that is not the middle of the range.
dna.declined: animation_type (WAVE/RIPPLE/RANDOM_WALK/CHAOTIC) is the obvious enum and declines twice over: it is time-domain, so a still catches one arbitrary phase, and it is dead in every placement anyway because the .tscn sets enable_animation false - promoting it would mean switching the animation on and changing what all three rooms do. chaos_level and height_scale change how MUCH relief there is and not what the relief claims. surface_color and emission_tint are which-colour, which is never an argument. `generator` is deliberately NOT borrowed from noise_space: that word names which CORRELATED basis fills a field, and this artifact's whole position in the sequence is that its vertices are independent, so taking the word would claim the two floors are the same kind of object.
dna.finding: THE FIELD IS DRAWN TWICE ON BOOT AND ONE OF THE TWO IS NEVER SEEN. super._ready() runs generate_space(), which builds the mesh from the first draw; _ready() then calls _generate_base_heights() again, leaving base_heights holding a second, different field that is never displayed while enable_animation is false - which it is in the .tscn, hence in all three rooms. Not repaired here, because repairing it would change which field those rooms show. apply_grid_config works around it instead: it reseeds before regenerating, so a rebuilt surface is the FIRST draw again and a config call that changes only the law changes only the law.
dna.still_note: law is resolved once per vertex before the mesh exists and never moves again, so one frame is a complete account of it. Expect poisson to be the loudest value - five discrete terraces against a continuum is a categorical change in the shading, not a shift in it - and exponential second, because it is the only law that moves the base level off centre. uniform-vs-gaussian is the subtle pair and the honest test of the framing: they share every peak and differ only in how much of the surface sits near the middle. If ALL SIX pairs come back under 1%, suspect the camera before the axis and check that dna.framing arrived.

random_walk_terrarium.description: A contained ecosystem where random walkers create terrain — trails accumulate into landscapes, paths cross to form structures, and the terrarium slowly fills with the emergent geography of stochastic exploration.
random_walk_terrarium.name: Random Walk Terrarium
random_walk_terrarium.qfep_connection: Random walk as pure E(S) â€” no memory, no direction, maximum entropy. LÃ©vy flights: structured randomness.

reset_area.description: Cartesian coordinate system, x y z godot
reset_area.name: Cube with shader
reset_area.qfep_connection: A kilometre-wide catch-plane hiding beneath the map, zeroing your velocity twice before setting you back at spawn — and manufacturing a spawn point if none exists. Falling out of the world is quietly made impossible; the floor under the floor is the promise that no failure here is terminal.

reset_cube.description: Cartesian coordinate system, x y z godot
reset_cube.name: Cube with shader
reset_cube.qfep_connection: The same catch-and-return logic as the hidden safety floor, shrunk to a pink shader-lit cylinder you must walk into. Reset recoded from net to door: going home becomes something the body chooses.

rhizome_navigator.description: Deleuze and Guattari rhizome as navigable graph.
rhizome_navigator.name: Rhizome Navigator
rhizome_navigator.qfep_connection: Every graph drawn on a table has a front, and a front is a beginning. Laid flat under the feet with twelve legal entrances, identical plinths, a hole where the trunk would stand, and a pulse that arrives from a different direction every few seconds, the rhizome stops being a picture of non-hierarchy and becomes a floor that cannot tell you where you started.

schlegel_diagram.name: Schlegel Diagram
schlegel_diagram.qfep_connection: Eight congruent cells, and the one nearest the observer gets to be the container -- the nesting a Schlegel diagram shows is a fact about the camera, not the polytope. It is perspective caught doing what perspective always does: converting proximity into hierarchy and then presenting the result as structure.

sequencer.description: Music and audio sequencer for algorithmic composition
sequencer.name: Sequencer
sequencer.qfep_connection: Named for music, it makes none — six light patterns (running dot, checkerboard, diagonal sweep) chase across a tile grid forever, timing rendered as pure albedo. The score without the sound: sequence itself, stripped to visible order.

settings_ui.name: settings_ui
settings_ui.qfep_connection: A dropdown where the curriculum's whole law of progression sits one enum from abolition — select Explorer and every sequence unlocks. The lock system admits, in a settings panel, that it was always a choice.

sine_wave_controller.description: Pair of value mappers that expose sine-wave frequency, amplitude, and phase and optionally drive the Mario slider rig.
sine_wave_controller.name: sine_wave_controller
sine_wave_controller.qfep_connection: A sine has exactly three degrees of freedom, and each gets a graspable body: a 2D pad for frequency and amplitude, a 1D slider for phase. The equation is never displayed; you learn its shape by holding its parameters.

soft_body_slicer.description: Cut soft bodies with a laser plane.
soft_body_slicer.name: Soft Body Slicer
soft_body_slicer.qfep_connection: A mesh boolean asks where the surface goes; a soft body has no surface, it has a graph, and the surface is a picture drawn of the graph afterwards. Cut the graph and the picture follows — cut the picture and nothing happens at all.

sol_lewitt_wall_drawing.description: Procedural wall drawings from text instructions.
sol_lewitt_wall_drawing.name: Sol LeWitt Wall Drawing
sol_lewitt_wall_drawing.qfep_connection: LeWitt sold the sentence, not the wall, so this artifact refuses to show one without the other: the rule is legible text at reading height and the execution is dense geometry beside it, and the seed proves the gap between them is real rather than rhetorical. Authorship here is a boundary that will not hold — the instruction is the work, the drafting is the work, and neither can be demoted to a copy of the other.

sparse_array_demo.description: Visualizes sparse vs dense 2D array storage. Toggle between full grid and sparse representation.
sparse_array_demo.name: Sparse Array Demo
sparse_array_demo.qfep_connection: Sparse arrays encode absence as information.

speed_display.name: speed_display
speed_display.qfep_connection: A label printing Engine.time_scale every frame — the one parameter the player lives inside, gauged. When the engine slows the world, everything slows in sympathy; this readout is the only witness that "1.00x" was ever anything but natural.

spit_text_3d.name: spit_text_3d
spit_text_3d.qfep_connection: Text arrives at typing speed, letter by letter, line by line, toggled from the A-button; dismissed, its labels are not hidden but freed. Reading restaged as duration, un-reading as deletion.

spring_chain.description: Chain of masses connected by springs. Drag one end and watch the wave propagate.
spring_chain.name: Spring Chain
spring_chain.qfep_connection: Spring chains are the discrete skeleton of wave equations.

spring_demo.description: A hands-on spring physics demonstration — stretch, compress, and release springs to feel Hooke's law in action. Visualizes the relationship between displacement, restoring force, and oscillation with real-time force vectors.
spring_demo.name: Spring Demo

dna.default: regime=ringing, trace=off - ringing is a no-op that leaves damping_c at its shipped 0.2 and the damping slider at its shipped 0..2 range, and trace=off builds no mesh, so the 7 existing placements gain nothing and lose nothing
dna.was: a demo whose own truth line names three regimes - ringing, critical, sluggish - while its slider topped out at c=2.0 against a critical damping of 6.32, so only the first was reachable; and a 300-sample phase-space trail collected every physics frame and never drawn
dna.note: declared by hand 2026-07-29 - the artifact exposed only three NodePaths, so the stage-2 sweep found no turnable knobs and declined it. regime is set as a damping RATIO (zeta = c / c_crit), so it survives changes to k and m, and it widens the damping slider so the named state is holdable by hand rather than only settable from a map token.

spring_network.name: Spring Network

standalone_disco.description: Self-contained disco floor with white tiles and pattern control. Config: width:8, depth:8, tile_size:0.5, show_controls:true
standalone_disco.name: Standalone Disco Floor
standalone_disco.qfep_connection: The array as dancefloor — a grid of tiles lighting in programmed patterns, the 2D array turned nightclub. Proof that the humblest data structure, a grid of cells each holding a state, is enough to choreograph a room. Indices become tiles, values become light.

surveillance_panopticon.description: Foucault panopticon. Central tower with CCTV cones.
surveillance_panopticon.name: Surveillance Panopticon
surveillance_panopticon.qfep_connection: Every tower surface is opaque and its one lit surface is a sealed band, while ten translucent cones make the watching legible from the cells and from nowhere else — visibility is built as a one-way material property, so the asymmetry needs no caption to survive. The sweep steps between cones without announcing itself: you can always read who is lit, never who is looking, and the tower works exactly as well with nobody inside it.

tesla_sparks.description: Tesla coil spark effects for electrical visualization
tesla_sparks.name: Tesla Sparks
tesla_sparks.qfep_connection: Every frame a fresh jagged path is rebuilt between two grabbable spheres — endpoints fixed by hands, every intermediate vertex jittered anew. E_flux on a leash: the randomness never escapes the segment your grip defines.

tesla_sphere.description: Tesla sphere for electrical field interaction
tesla_sphere.name: Tesla Sphere
tesla_sphere.qfep_connection: A glowing pickable with gravity_scale −0.1, drifting faintly upward until held; its grab handler either emits a signal or files progress with a TaskManagerController. Touch is scored — the moment of grasp is where play gets audited.

text_display.name: text_display
text_display.qfep_connection: A violet glass pane carrying a 2D page inside a Viewport2Din3D, ringed by a hand-pose area that bends any approaching hand into a point. The scene decides how the body reads before a word appears: pages here demand a finger.

transform_matrix_cube.description: Interactive 3D cube with its transformation matrix displayed in real-time. Rotate, scale, and translate the cube while watching the 4x4 matrix update — making the abstract algebra of linear transformations concrete and visual.
transform_matrix_cube.name: Transform Matrix Cube
transform_matrix_cube.qfep_connection: Matrix as transformation rule â€” how one space maps to another. det(M) shows information preservation/loss.

tts_test.name: TTS Test
tts_test.qfep_connection: One hard-coded sentence spoken aloud, then an audit that "tts" exists in the UtilityRegistry, reported to the console as check or cross. Speech in this world is a grid utility — a voice must be registered before it can be heard.

turing_pattern_generator.description: Generate reaction-diffusion Turing patterns in real-time — spots, stripes, and labyrinthine structures emerge from the interplay of activator and inhibitor chemicals diffusing at different rates. Alan Turing's morphogenesis made visible.

dna.framing_why: MEASURED, and it is the whole story rather than a polish pass. The update rule was ported to numpy and the six regimes compared ON THE TEXTURE at the fixture (resolution 40, 1600 steps): spots vs coral changes 15-21% of the pattern cells and stripes vs coral changes 93%. The sweep reported 0.497% and 2.089%. The ratio is the frame - the pattern is a 1 x 1 m quad lying FLAT and photographed from 14.9 degrees above the horizon, so it presents 0.257 of its own area, and the union box is stretched to a 1.68 m diagonal by the VR control panel at z=0.65 and the framed info plate at z=-0.58. 2.7% of frame times 20% of the pattern is 0.54%, which reproduces the measurement to within a tenth of a percent: the axis was never weak, the camera was 5.2 m away. 0.6 is set against a computed clipping limit - the widest screen extent is the far corner of the base plate at 0.765 m, so the camera cannot come closer than 0.48, and 0.6 keeps a quarter of the frame as margin while multiplying every measured area by 2.78. Uniform scale is not an alternative: display_size scales the AABB with the artifact, so the camera pulls back by the same factor and nothing is gained.
dna.fixture_why: MANDATORY, three separate reasons, and all three default to shipped behaviour in code so none of them is an axis. pattern_seed pins the five seeded blobs - _seed_random draws them with the global randi_range, so six regime frames would be six different inoculations and the bite number would measure the RNG, not the feed/kill pair (the generative-artifact trap). warmup runs the chemistry before the first frame: at the shipped 4 steps per frame a 0.35 s settle reaches step 84 and all six values photograph the same five undifferentiated blobs. resolution 40 rather than the shipped 64 is a TIME budget, not a look - this is an interpreted CPU Gray-Scott loop and 1600 steps at 64x64 is 6.5 M cell updates inside _ready, which blocks the boot past the capture watchdog; the code caps it at 4 M regardless of what a fixture asks for.
dna.fixture_ladder: Measured, not assumed. The update rule was re-implemented exactly (same 0.2/0.05 laplacian weights, same clamp, same 5-disc seeding) and run per preset at 32/40/48/64 cells and 300-6000 steps. The six regimes are indistinguishable below ~800 steps and fully settled by ~2000; at resolution 40 / 1600 steps the V-coverage reads spots 0.06, stripes 0.21, maze 0.16, mitosis 0.07, coral 0.03, waves 0.13, and every pair differs by at least 0.04 mean |dV| per cell (most by over 0.11). Two facts worth knowing before reading the sheet: at the shipped seeding (U=0.5, V=0.25 in five discs) the Coral preset very nearly dies out - it settles at 3% coverage - and the Spots preset stabilises as a handful of isolated dots rather than filling the field. Those are facts about the presets, not about the capture.
dna.deepened: 2026-08-05, two moves, and the first one is a correction of the verdict rather than of the artifact. (1) dna.framing 0.6. The regime axis is not close to weak: ported to numpy at the fixture settings, the six presets differ by 15% (spots vs coral, the reported worst pair) to 93% (stripes vs coral) OF THE PATTERN CELLS. The sweep saw 0.497% and 2.089% because the pattern surface is only about 2.7% of the frame, and 2.7% x 20% = 0.54% reproduces the reported number almost exactly. A flat 1 m plate seen from 14.9 degrees shows a quarter of its area, and a control panel 0.65 m away in +z and a framed info plate 0.58 m away in -z stretch the fitted diagonal to 1.68 m. Nothing about the chemistry needed changing. (2) A SECOND AXIS, `seeding`, which is the argument this file's own truth line makes and no knob could reach: 'pattern emerges from the ratio of two diffusion rates - not from a template, not from a gene'. regime moves feed and kill; the truth sentence is about neither, and every placement in the corpus has started from the same five random discs since the artifact was written. The four values were chosen by measurement, not taste - all four run at all six regimes, and the value list is what survived: `noise` was tried at five densities from 0.08 to 0.8 and no density ignites more than two regimes, so it was dropped rather than shipped as four blank tiles; `band` was dropped because under mitosis it and `ring` both die to an empty field, which is two values showing one picture, the twin fault the critic exists to catch. THE RESULT IS TWO-SIDED, which is why it is worth having: under `maze` the four seedings settle at coverage 0.434 / 0.410 / 0.443 / 0.440 while 39-73% of the CELLS differ - the law fixes how much, the seed fixes where, and the truth line holds. Under `waves` the lattice never ignites and under `mitosis` the ring dies out, so the seed also decides IF there is a pattern at all. Minimum pairwise texture difference across all six regimes is 9.7% and the median is around 45%, comparable to regime's own spread. NOT MEASURED YET: 6 x 4 is 24 variants and build_dna_gallery's default cap is 9, which keeps the first axis that fits and silently drops the second - this needs --max=24. Worth knowing regardless: the last sweep of `regime` only rendered FIVE values. Cap trimming drops from the END of the list, so `waves` - the preset furthest from the others in the phase space, at f=0.014 / k=0.047 - is the one value that has never been photographed.
dna.default: regime=spots, seeding=discs - both no-ops. _seed_discs is the shipped inoculation moved into a named function and not otherwise touched: the same five discs, the same random centres and radii, drawn in the same order and the same count from the same generator, so an existing placement is inoculated byte for byte as before. apply_grid_config pulls `seeding` out of the blanket write-through loop for the same reason it pulls `regime` - writing the word alone would change what the RESET button draws next while leaving the field on screen inoculated the old way, so the artifact would be labelled one thing and showing another - and it re-seeds only when the word validates against SEEDINGS, DIFFERS from the one held, and _ready has already built the grids. None of the 14 rooms sends either key. AND, unchanged from the promotion: regime=spots - spots is PRESETS[0], which is f=0.055 / k=0.062, which is the pattern_type the .tscn has always written on the root. _resolve_regime assigns pattern_type ONLY when the resolved index differs, so at the default not one byte is written and the setter never fires; _ready is otherwise the same six calls in the same order. pattern_seed and warmup both default to 0, which is the shipped fresh-every-launch inoculation and no pre-run at all, so a player still meets the blank field and watches it organise. apply_grid_config keeps its legacy write-through loop untouched and handles regime separately, guarded on the word being one PRESETS builds and on it differing; neither of the two curation bays nor the five museum trials that mount this artifact sends it, so all 14 rooms are unchanged.
dna.was: no declared axis - the runner refused this token for NO TURNABLE KNOBS, and the axis was already sitting in the source. The six-point phase space was an @export_enum INT called pattern_type with a working setter and a VR slider wired to it, and the registry had never been told. Worse, the integer was unreachable from a map token even by hand: map_data.json config values arrive as STRINGS and apply_grid_config's whole body was a blanket `if key in self: set(key, ...)`, so 'turing_pattern_generator#pattern_type:2' tried to write "2" into a typed int, was rejected, and silently rendered Spots. Fourteen placements, one regime.
dna.note: hand promotion 2026-08-04, the lsystem_editor case again. regime is the corpus's word for 'which named case of this system's parameter space is in force' (harmonic_motion_demo, mass_spring_damper, bouncing_ball, bifurcation_diagram) and the values are DERIVED from PRESETS - _regime_index reads the third column of the table, so the declared list cannot drift from the code the way science_screen's did. The axis is deliberately the named regime and NOT feed or kill as continuous floats: this loop's evidence is one still per value, a slider position is not a claim, and the whole teaching point of the @identity ('each preset is a point in that space') is that the interesting structure is a handful of named islands. CAUTION ON RECORD: reaction_diffusion, the GPU sibling this file's @identity names, was measured GENUINELY INERT - 62% of frame and 15 grey levels. That verdict was about a continuous parameter on an unwarmed field; the regimes here differ by a factor of seven in coverage once the chemistry has actually run.
